exceptions.rationale: The optional Linux tray currently depends on the GTK3 tao/tray-icon/libappindicator stack, which cannot consume the fixed glib release without replacing that backend. P2WLAN does not call glib::VariantStrIter.
exceptions.mitigation: Keep the native tray opt-in, run the native tray and full workspace tests, and remove this exception when the tray stack has a GTK4-compatible backend.
